court_name: High Court of Andhra Pradesh at Amaravati

directives.text: the present Criminal Appeal is dismissed confirming the conviction and sentence recorded by the learned I Additional District and Sessions Judge, Chittoor in Sessions Case No.15 of 2014, dated 26.07.2018.
Miscellaneous petitions, if any, pending in the Criminal Appeal, shall stand closed.

raw_summary: The High Court of Andhra Pradesh dismissed a criminal appeal, upholding the conviction and life sentence of the appellant (Gilakalagiri) for offenses under Sections 363, 302 IPC and Section 6 of POCSO Act, 2012. The appellant was found guilty of kidnapping, murder, and aggravated penetrative sexual assault of a 6-year-old girl. The court confirmed the lower court's judgment, finding no grounds to interfere with the conviction and sentence.
